raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`RecoverSWAWithLockedFull` bundles three steps in one `SWAComponent` handler: move the incoming request's SWA mapping onto the node's kept Full ids, free the incoming Full ids, and publish the recovered value on the node. Only the first step is the same for every SWA component. Whether the handler may free the incoming Full ids or write the node depends on who owns them at that point in the tree walk, so a tree core that frees duplicate Full ids and publishes nodes itself cannot reuse the recovery as it stands, and a component with its own mapping layout has to re-implement the whole handler to change the mapping step.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_cache/components/swa.py`: the mapping move becomes `SWAComponent._set_swa(kept_full, incoming_full)`, which returns the recovered SWA value and keeps both existing recipes: the page-ownership rebind through `_transfer_swa_pages` on the unified pool, and the `full_to_swa` clear-then-set writes on a static allocator. `RecoverSWAWithLockedFull` calls it and then, as before, frees only the incoming Full side (through the composite on the unified pool, through `free_full_segment` otherwise) and stores the value on the node. The new `RecoverEvictedSWA` branch runs `_set_swa` alone.
- `python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_cache/cache_action.py`: `RecoverEvictedSWA(component_type, kept_full, incoming_full)`, the mapping-only component action. Its `component_type` has no default, since it is addressed to whichever SWA-style component owns the mapping; Full cleanup and tree publication stay with the caller.
- `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_swa_locked_full_recover_unified.py`: two cases for the new action, on the unified composite and on the static recorder, checking that the node's ids adopt the incoming SWA pages while no Full id is freed and no device value is published. They guard against folding either step back into the shared helper, which would double-free under a caller that still owns them. The existing locked-full cases are unchanged and still pass.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model or kernel path changes. Locked-full recovery performs the same allocator calls as before in both the unified and the static branch; the existing handler tests in `test_swa_locked_full_recover_unified.py` and `test_unified_radix_cache_unittest.py` cover both.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the handler issues the same allocator operations in the same order relative to the free; only the publication now happens through a shared code path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit): formatting, lint, import sorting and spelling checks pass on the three changed files.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests): `test_swa_locked_full_recover_unified.py`, `test_unified_radix_cache_unittest.py`, `test_swa_unittest.py`, `test_unified_cache_linker.py` and `test_multi_ended_allocator.py` pass on CPU with the change.
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations): none needed.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed): see above.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -98,6 +98,15 @@ class RecoverSWAWithLockedFull(ComponentAction, frozen=True):
     component_type: ComponentType = ComponentType.SWA
 
 
+class RecoverEvictedSWA(ComponentAction, frozen=True):
+    """Recover evicted SWA on kept Full IDs by moving the incoming SWA mapping,
+    leaving Full cleanup and tree publication to the caller."""
+
+    component_type: ComponentType
+    kept_full: torch.Tensor
+    incoming_full: torch.Tensor
+
+
 class SWARebuild(ComponentAction, frozen=True):
     """Rebuild a node's SWA value by translating its source full value, then store it."""

@@ -27,6 +27,7 @@
     FreeComponentHostSlot,
     FreeDeviceKVFullOnly,
     RebuildFullToSWAMapping,
+    RecoverEvictedSWA,
     RecoverSWAWithLockedFull,
     SWARebuild,
 )
@@ -305,6 +306,21 @@ def _transfer_swa_pages(
         swa.virtual_to_physical.index_fill_(0, incoming_pages, -1)
         swa.clear_inverse_history()
 
+    def _set_swa(
+        self, kept_full: torch.Tensor, incoming_full: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Move incoming SWA mappings to kept Full IDs and return SWA indices."""
+        unified = self._unified_allocator()
+        if unified is not None:
+            self._transfer_swa_pages(unified, kept_full, incoming_full)
+            return self._translate_full_to_swa(kept_full)
+
+        allocator = self.cache.token_to_kv_pool_allocator
+        swa_value = self._translate_full_to_swa(incoming_full)
+        allocator.clear_full_to_swa_mapping(incoming_full)
+        allocator.set_full_to_swa_mapping(kept_full, swa_value)
+        return swa_value
+
     def refresh_lru(
         self,
         phase: LRURefreshPhase,
@@ -1538,29 +1554,19 @@ def apply_component_action(self, action: ComponentAction) -> None:
             for full, swa in zip(action.full_indices, action.swa_indices):
                 alloc.set_full_to_swa_mapping(full, swa)
             return
+        if isinstance(action, RecoverEvictedSWA):
+            self._set_swa(action.kept_full, action.incoming_full)
+            return
         if isinstance(action, RecoverSWAWithLockedFull):
             # Keep the locked full; hand the node the INCOMING ids' swa pages,
             # freeing only the incoming full, then store the swa on the node.
+            swa_value = self._set_swa(action.kept_full, action.incoming_full)
             unified = self._unified_allocator()
             if unified is not None:
-                # No `full_to_swa_index_mapping` here: the swa sub-pool's v2p IS
-                # the mapping. Rebind page ownership, then free through the
-                # composite -- its `swa_v2p_pages > 0` filter skips the
-                # just-tombstoned swa side, releasing only the full one.
-                self._transfer_swa_pages(
-                    unified, action.kept_full, action.incoming_full
-                )
+                # The composite skips the detached SWA side and releases Full.
                 unified.free(action.incoming_full)
-                self.tree_core.set_component_device_value(
-                    action.node_id,
-                    self.component_type,
-                    self._translate_full_to_swa(action.kept_full),
-                )
-                return
-            swa_value = self._translate_full_to_swa(action.incoming_full)
-            alloc.set_full_to_swa_mapping(action.kept_full, swa_value)
-            alloc.clear_full_to_swa_mapping(action.incoming_full)
-            alloc.free_full_segment(action.incoming_full, start_pos=0)
+            else:
+                alloc.free_full_segment(action.incoming_full, start_pos=0)
             self.tree_core.set_component_device_value(
                 action.node_id, self.component_type, swa_value
             )

@@ -35,7 +35,10 @@
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocator.unified_hybrid_swa import (
     UnifiedSWATokenToKVPoolAllocator,
 )
-from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.cache_action import RecoverSWAWithLockedFull
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.cache_action import (
+    RecoverEvictedSWA,
+    RecoverSWAWithLockedFull,
+)
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.component_type import ComponentType
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components.swa import SWAComponent
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_memory_pool import MHASubPoolSpec, UnifiedKVPool
@@ -292,5 +295,65 @@ def test_static_allocator_keeps_the_mapping_recipe(self):
         self.assertEqual((node_id, ct), (3, _SWA))
 
 
+class TestRecoverEvictedSWAHandler(_RecoverTestBase):
+    """`RecoverEvictedSWA` is the mapping-only step of locked-full recovery:
+    the node's ids adopt the incoming swa pages, while the incoming FULL ids
+    and the node's device value stay with the caller. Folding either into the
+    shared step would double-free under a tree core that still owns them."""
+
+    def test_unified_pool_moves_ownership_and_frees_nothing(self):
+        probe, allocator = self._probe()
+        swa = allocator.swa_attn_allocator
+        kept, incoming = self._two_ranges(allocator)
+        allocator.free_swa(kept)  # what eviction does when it tombstones
+        swa_live = swa.allocated_count()
+        full_avail = allocator.full_attn_allocator.available_size()
+
+        probe.apply_component_action(
+            RecoverEvictedSWA(
+                component_type=_SWA, kept_full=kept, incoming_full=incoming
+            )
+        )
+
+        self.assertTrue(
+            bool((allocator.translate_loc_from_full_to_swa(kept) > 0).all()),
+            "the node's ids must address live swa pages after recovery",
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(
+            bool((swa.virtual_to_physical[incoming.to(torch.int64)] == -1).all()),
+            "the incoming ids' swa side must be tombstoned",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(swa.allocated_count(), swa_live, "ownership only moved")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            allocator.full_attn_allocator.available_size(),
+            full_avail,
+            "the incoming FULL side belongs to the caller",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(probe.tree_core.set_calls, [], "publication is the caller's")
+
+    def test_static_allocator_moves_the_mapping_and_frees_nothing(self):
+        static = _StaticAllocRecorder()
+        probe = _Probe.__new__(_Probe)
+        probe.cache = _Cache(static)
+        probe.tree_core = _StubTreeCore()
+
+        kept = torch.tensor([1, 2], dtype=torch.int64)
+        incoming = torch.tensor([5, 6], dtype=torch.int64)
+        donated = static.full_to_swa_index_mapping[incoming].clone()
+        probe.apply_component_action(
+            RecoverEvictedSWA(
+                component_type=_SWA, kept_full=kept, incoming_full=incoming
+            )
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            static.full_to_swa_index_mapping[kept].tolist(), donated.tolist()
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(len(static.clear_calls), 1, "incoming must be tombstoned")
+        self.assertEqual(static.freed_full, [])
+        self.assertEqual(static.freed_via_inner, [])
+        self.assertEqual(probe.tree_core.set_calls, [])
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
